note: Proposed by Glyph for Latch (brief 047). Move to unity/Assets/Suborned/Resources/Loading/loading.json; the picture sits beside it as Resources/Loading/<image.name>.png. Swapping the picture = drop in a new png, change image.name and, if the sky or faces are elsewhere, title.rect. No code change. All sizes are 'ref px' at 1080p height: device px = ref x (screen height / 1080).

image.name: loading_bg
image.note: B_after.png (briefs/047/fix/), 2560x1440, Forma's fixed take. Copy to Resources/Loading/loading_bg.png (import: sRGB, no mips, bilinear, no compression, max size 4096; it is 3.7 MP, 15 MB as RGBA, keep it out of the atlas).

pushIn.note: optional slow push toward focus; 0 = still. Layout is measured at scale 1; the push moves nothing by more than 2 %.

frame.note: Nothing but the picture and the scrims goes outside this frame.

scrims.note: carries the bar, the loading line and the build line over any paving
gives the title cream-on-ink contrast over a mid-blue sky (about 4.9:1 at the title); a different picture with a dark top can set alphaAtEdge to 0

rect.note: image-normalised (0..1 of the picture, so it follows the crop). B: the open sky right of the Enforcer's head (head spans x 0.49-0.54, shoulder tops reach x 0.60 at y 0.20), left of the right-hand tower (x 0.78 at y 0.08). The lockup is fitted inside it, never outside.

rule.note: brass hairline, the one brass use (thin line only, art bible)

loadingLine.head: Loading

percent.note: tabular, right end of the bar, whole numbers, 0-100

loadingLine.note: left, above the bar. The stage text comes from the loader (a short noun: 'Harbour District', 'People', 'Plan'); empty = the line shows the head only. No sentences.
